claims.statement: Workshop painting by Verrocchio. Leonardo's hand is generally recognised in the left angel and parts of the landscape. The allocation of passages is a scholarly judgement.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Style and technique; attribution of passages.
